# GXEON Paid API

> Pay-per-request JSON validation for software and AI agents.

## Current x402 launch scope

- JSON Validate: POST https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/x402/json-validate
  - Price: 0.01 USDC per request
  - Network: Base mainnet (CAIP-2: eip155:8453)
  - Service ID: gxeon_json_validate_v1
  - Input: JSON object with payload (any JSON value or raw JSON string) and optional lightweight schema.
  - Output: valid flag, structured errors, parsed type, byte length, optional object key count, and GXEON receipt.

CSV Audit is in technical recovery after independent paid attempts returned HTTP 503 without a delivered result. It is not currently advertised as an x402 paid route. A separate authenticated Zyla staging origin is documented in openapi.zyla.csv.yaml on the Zyla integration branch; it is not the x402 route and must remain in draft until the Zyla gateway test succeeds.

## x402 v2 payment flow

1. Send POST with Content-Type: application/json and no payment header.
2. Receive HTTP 402 and decode PAYMENT-REQUIRED (base64 JSON).
3. Sign the exact terms in the challenge using an x402 v2-compatible wallet/client.
4. Retry the exact same POST body with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
5. On HTTP 200, retain PAYMENT-RESPONSE, X-402-Receipt, X-402-Settlement and the JSON receipt.

Never create a second payment to recover a pending delivery. For HTTP 503, honor Retry-After and retry only with the same request body and original PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. If delivery remains unavailable, contact support with the transaction hash. Never share payment signatures or authorization secrets.

## JSON Validate example

```bash
curl -i https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/x402/json-validate \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"payload":{"ready":true},"schema":{"type":"object","required":["ready"],"properties":{"ready":{"type":"boolean"}}}}'
```

## Machine-readable specification

- OpenAPI 3.1: /openapi.yaml
- Agent guide: /llms.txt

## Money and reliability semantics

An HTTP 402 quote is not a completed sale. Count revenue only after on-chain settlement is independently verified and the service returns its result with a GXEON receipt. A validation result with valid=false is still a successful delivery of a negative finding; an HTTP 503 is not.

Public listing and price do not guarantee discovery, buyer demand, or revenue. Do not pay again to recover a pending delivery.
